## AC12 satisfied — `sweep (macos, full suite)` is green on `main`

Mirror Test Suite run `35572919806`, dispatched against `0ca99c39f90` (the commit that
landed this fix):

```
sweep (macos, full suite) :: completed / success
```

This is the job that had been failing since `5aa0eef98fd` with 4 errors in
`tests/infra/test_mcp_entrypoint.py`, all `flock: command not found`. It is not
`continue-on-error`, so it is what had `main` red. `main` is green again.

### Process note worth recording

`.github/workflows/test.yml` sets `concurrency: group: test-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}`
with `cancel-in-progress: true`. Two `workflow_dispatch` runs on `main` therefore share one
lane and the newer cancels the older. An earlier run in this session
(`35566050792`) had its `sweep (windows)` job cancelled mid-flight by a second dispatch,
destroying evidence another ticket was waiting on. Only one on-demand main-health dispatch
can be in flight at a time.

Related: that workflow's `push` trigger carries `branches-ignore: ["feature/**", "main", "tickets"]`,
so merging to `main` never triggers it. Health on `main` comes only from the 6-hourly
schedule (`cron: "41 */6 * * *"`) or a manual dispatch. That is why this breakage went
unnoticed for roughly 11 hours.
